title: Decoding an encoded list of words
statement: For every finite list $L$ of finite bit strings, encode each word $x$ as the self-delimiting pair of $x$ with the empty bit string, and concatenate these encodings. Applying the recursive word-list decoder to the resulting bit string recovers $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of finite bit strings
